name: Kusugawa Sasara
source:
Sasara is a new heroine who appears in the releases subsequent to the PlayStation 2 version. She is one school year older than the protagonist and the student council vice-president/the later president. She has a cold demeanour and strict attitude and as a result, her only friend is Maaryan. When it is time for Maaryan to graduate, Sasara is saddened because her only friend would be leaving her and even attempts to convince Maaryan not to graduate. [url=/c15061]Takaaki[/url] becomes acquainted with her after he is chosen to be a volunteer to help the student council with an event, but when Sasara becomes president, under certain circumstances he becomes the treasurer. While working with Takaaki in the student council she begins to develop a crush on him.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_To_Heart_series_characters#To_Heart_2]Wikipedia[/url]]
